decisions.reason: The supplement range anchors the pharmacy OTC line, costs little to maintain and is still early, so keeping the option open has clear value.
It was recently launched with its own page and active promotion, so uncertainty about demand has not resolved and keeping it costs little.
Joint health is a stable pharmacy category that fits the Trivital brand, and one year is too short to judge, so the cheap option should stay open.
Mushroom-based immune products are a niche with only minor website presence, but holding them is inexpensive while market response is still unclear.
The 2018 NDMA recall of valsartan has shown that this low-margin generic faces costly API resourcing and reputational damage, so abandoning it frees resources better used elsewhere.
